beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Welcome to the sim, Starbuck. Painted drones, real rules. The clock is frozen while we talk.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Those ships along the bottom are the fleet. Fleet health, up top, is how much of them is left. If it reaches zero, the entire run is lost.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Chief, I have more flight hours than this sim has lines of code.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Just get the training Viper back in one piece, Starbuck.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Drag anywhere on the screen, or use WASD or the arrows, to move your Viper.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Your guns fire on their own. You fly, they shoot. First drill: one drone, and it will not shoot back. Get under it.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Finally, a Viper that gets me.

lessons.heading: They shoot back
lessons.recap: Your guns fire on their own: you only fly. Real Raiders shoot back.

fallback.speaker: tyrol
fallback.text: Still chasing it? Fine. You only fly; the guns do the rest.

fallback.speaker: tyrol
fallback.text: Real Raiders shoot back, so here come two that do. Stay under them.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Scratch one. That is the whole trick: you fly, the guns do the rest.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Real Raiders shoot back, so here come two that do. Stay under them.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Now THAT is a party.

lessons.heading: Stray round
lessons.recap: A round that misses you turns orange and keeps going. When it reaches the ships at the bottom, fleet health drops.

fallback.speaker: tyrol
fallback.text: A round that misses you does not vanish. It turns orange and keeps going, down to the ships at the bottom.

fallback.speaker: tyrol
fallback.text: That is how the fleet gets hurt, and it is how you lose. Dodge, and the fleet eats the round. Block, and your Viper does.

fallback.speaker: tyrol
fallback.text: I patch your hull at every jump. The fleet only gets a little fixed up. Choose every time.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Look. That orange round missed you, and it is still going. It is about to hit the fleet. Watch fleet health when it lands.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Rounds that get past you are how the fleet gets hurt, and how you lose. Dodge, and the fleet eats it. Block, and your Viper does.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: So dodging is bad now?

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: I patch your hull at every jump. The fleet only gets a little fixed up. What do you think?

lessons.heading: They come back
lessons.recap: A destroyed Raider leaves a blip with a bar. When it fills, about six seconds later, the Raider is back, marked Returned.

fallback.speaker: tyrol
fallback.text: When you destroy a Raider it leaves a blip with a little bar. That is it downloading into a new body.

fallback.speaker: tyrol
fallback.text: About six seconds later it comes back, marked Returned. Loop on, up top, means that is still happening.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: See the ones marked Returned? That is your first raider kills coming back. The blip it left, with the little bar, was it downloading into a new body.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Your sim cheats.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Out there, the Cylons do that themselves, until the resurrection ship is gone. 'Loop on', up top, means it is still happening.

lessons.heading: Your hull
lessons.recap: The pips on your Viper are its hull. Five hits and you eject. The hull is patched at every jump.

fallback.speaker: tyrol
fallback.text: The pips on your Viper are your hull, and Hull up top counts them. Five hits and you eject.

fallback.speaker: starbuck
fallback.text: Nobody has touched me yet, Chief.

fallback.speaker: tyrol
fallback.text: Give it time. I patch the hull at every jump.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: You took a hit. The pips on your Viper are your hull, and Hull up top counts them. Five hits and you eject.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: The good news: that round did not reach the fleet. I patch your hull at every jump.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: That is the jump clock. Every cycle is 33 seconds, in the sim and out there. Then the fleet jumps.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: The last eight seconds are the spool. It says Spooling and turns amber. Stop chasing kills and cover the fleet.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: The jump clears every round in the air. Just get there.

lessons.heading: Repairs
lessons.recap: At each jump the fleet gets a little fixed up, never all the way. Your hull and missiles are refilled.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Jumped. I patched the fleet from {before}% to {after}%. It gets a little fixed up between cycles, never all the way.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Your hull and missiles are topped up too. That part I can do properly.

lessons.heading: Pick a card
lessons.recap: Between cycles, pick one of three cards. Each changes the rules a little. Refresh the list deals one new hand.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Pick one of three cards. Each one changes the rules a little, and some cost you something.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: There is no timer. Refresh the list deals a new hand, once. Apply starts the next cycle.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Shopping. My favorite part.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Next cycle is the full sim. More drones, and some of them will stop shooting at you and dive straight at the fleet.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Rude.

lessons.heading: The resurrection ship
lessons.recap: The resurrection ship is why Raiders come back. It arrives shielded; wait for the shield to drop.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: And that is the resurrection ship. It is the reason the Raiders keep coming back.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Right now it is shielded, so your rounds just splash off. The shield drops next cycle. The line up top says what the run wants.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: So I wait.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: No, you keep the fleet safe from the Raiders. The ship will be open soon.

lessons.heading: Strafing run
lessons.recap: A Raider with a line down to the fleet is diving it. If it gets there it hits the fleet hard. Get under it and cut it off.

fallback.speaker: tyrol
fallback.text: Watch for a Raider with a line down to the fleet. It is diving it, and if it gets there it hits far harder than a stray round.

fallback.speaker: tyrol
fallback.text: Get under it and cut it off.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: See the line from that drone down to the fleet? It is diving it. If it gets there, it hits far harder than a stray round.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Get under it and cut it off.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: On it.

lessons.heading: Missiles
lessons.recap: Missiles: Space on a keyboard, or the missile button or a second finger on a phone. Three per cycle.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Missiles. Space on a keyboard. On a phone, the missile button or a tap with a second finger.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Three per cycle. The small reticle shows what it locks. It hits the first thing in its path.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Only three?

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Budget cuts.

lessons.heading: A heavy
lessons.recap: A heavy Raider is bigger and slower, takes eight hits, and a missile does three to it. It never comes back.

fallback.speaker: tyrol
fallback.text: Watch for heavies. Bigger, slower, eight hits to kill, and a missile only does three.

fallback.speaker: tyrol
fallback.text: The good news: heavies never come back.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Big one. A heavy takes eight hits, and a missile only does three to it.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: The good news: heavies never come back.

lessons.heading: The Speech
lessons.recap: The Speech (E, or its button): for four seconds the Raiders hold fire and you cannot be hurt. Ready again every third jump.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: 'The Speech' is a rare weaponized ability. It stops all raiders short as they listen to the inspirational words. Press E, or the speech button.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: For four seconds the drones hold fire and nothing can hurt you.

beats.speaker: adama
beats.text: Use it wisely, Starbuck. I can only inspire everyone every three jumps.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: The Old Man gets all the good lines.

lessons.heading: Ejected
lessons.recap: If your hull runs out, you eject. A Raptor picks you up a few seconds later. It costs time, never the run.

fallback.speaker: tyrol
fallback.text: If your hull runs out, you eject. A Raptor picks you up a few seconds later. It costs time, never the run.

fallback.speaker: starbuck
fallback.text: I do not plan on finding out.

fallback.speaker: tyrol
fallback.text: Nobody plans on it. And the fleet is on its own until you are back.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Ow.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: You ejected. A Raptor picks you up in a few seconds. It costs time, but it won't cause you to lose.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: The fleet is on its own until then, though, and it can take damage.

lessons.heading: Shield down
lessons.recap: When the shield drops, the ship can be hurt. Missiles do the most damage. Its hull stays down across jumps.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Shield is down. Hit it. Missiles do the most damage.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Whatever you take off it stays off, even across a jump.

lessons.heading: Loop offline
lessons.recap: With the resurrection ship gone the loop is offline: kills stay dead. Clear the last waves to win.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: It is down. Loop offline: whatever you destroy now stays destroyed.

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: Clear the last of them and the sim is done.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Now we are talking.

debrief.heading: Sim complete

beats.speaker: tyrol
beats.text: That is the sim. The real thing is longer, and the damage is more painful.

beats.speaker: starbuck
beats.text: Please. I was showing off.

debrief.recapIntro: The sim never got to these:
grades: Certified. Please stop buzzing the hangar deck.
Certified. The sim needs a lie-down.
